summary: Durable caller-bound business cost observation journal (PLF22321 slice1)

delivery.outcome: PLF-22321 slice1: durable trusted case grants, cost admission and actual-attempt accounting replay with pinned pricing/FX, unknown fee reconciliation and atomic canonical event exports. Gateway wiring is the explicitly dependent slice2.
nonGoals: No production/customer activation, routing or model-priority change, default price, implicit FX, new dependency or provider request replay.
Do not modify managed governance or native advisory lease projection; newer allocator/controller compatibility remains PLF-22311.
Gateway transport/client attempt seam excluded and preserved in external snapshot for dependent slice2; no competing implementation.

architecture.decision: One stdlib component persists grants, per-request observation admission, canonical events and pricing provenance in SQLite. A ContextVar carries the authenticated server binding into the existing actual-attempt observer seam. The gateway opts in through trusted composition, and reuses KpiCostLedger for business events.

dataChanges.description: Private observation/grant journal and atomically exported canonical cost stream; no existing billing/history schema migration.

architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded source change through protected publication.

validation.evidence: durable replay/restart, FX, unknown, failure, concurrency and export tests

commands: Protected native CI and independent Validator merge
validation.evidence: exact-head test and terminal merge receipts
